errors.text: The proposed validation compares free energies between two liquid temperatures rather than directly validating the MTP-to-DFT free-energy perturbation correction and its phase-space overlap; this may not detect errors relevant to solid-liquid free-energy differences or melting.

The mechanism inaccurately frames the avoided thermodynamic integration as a path through a solid-liquid coexistence region, whereas the key replacement is reference-potential-to-DFT integration using FEP when MTP and DFT energy differences have sufficiently low variance.
